The '''TIE/dg starfighter''', also known as the '''TIE Dagger'''<ref name="TIE Fighters" /> or the '''Sith TIE fighter''',<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|num=75272|name=Sith TIE Fighter}}</ref> was a type of [[Sith Eternal]]-affiliated [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]] [[starship]] that was forged in secret by forces under the command of the reborn [[Darth Sidious]], along with the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[AAL-2100/9.5 atmospheric assault lander]], and other new technology created by the [[Sith cult]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:TIEDagger-DB.png|thumb|left|250px|A Sith Eternal TIE Dagger]]
The TIE/dg was part of the TIE line of ships that had previously served as the [[starfighter]] of choice for both the [[Galactic Empire]] and [[First Order]]. It had an armament of [[laser cannon]]s beneath the ball [[cockpit]], and two [[heavy laser cannon]]s between the solar collector wing and the suspended winglet. These cannons gave it a deadly punch in starfighter combat. It was manufactured by [[Sienar-Jaemus Fleet Systems]] and had [[Color|red]] designs representing their loyalty to the Sith. It had a [[cockpit]], two triangular-shaped wings that featured [[solar collector]]s,<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> and [[twin ion engine]]s<ref name="USW" /> capable of reaching staggering [[Sublight engine|sublight]] speeds of 150 [[Megalight per hour|MGLT]].<ref name="SW EOSAOV (SE)" />

The TIE/dg replaced the two handle yoke of the original TIE's design with two independent control columns, which had levered handgrips that offered a greater degree of movement. Feedback on the columns created a strong sense of connection between the fighter and it's pilot.<ref name="EpIXVD" /> TIE Daggers could be piloted by [[Sith trooper]]s.<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref>

==History==
The TIE/dg was a new generation of starfighter<ref name="TIE databank">{{Databank|tie-dagger|TIE dagger}}</ref> that saw use during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the First Order and the [[Resistance]].<ref name="Episode IX" /> At some point, two TIE Daggers engaged Resistance [[pilot]] [[Aftab Ackbar]], who was piloting a [[BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter]], over a body of [[water]].<ref name="Aftab card">{{FFGXW2|set=BTA-NR2 Y-Wing Expansion Pack|cardname=Aftab Ackbar}}</ref> At another point, at least two TIE/dg fighters were involved in an engagement over [[mountain]]ous terrain; while one chased Resistance pilot [[C'ai Threnalli]], who was returning fire in his BTA-NR2, another TIE Dagger had been shot and was veering away.<ref name="C'ai card">{{FFGXW2|set=BTA-NR2 Y-Wing Expansion Pack|cardname=C'ai Threnalli}}</ref>

The fighter was one of the three ship classes used by the [[Sith Eternal]], the others being the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer and the [[AAL-2100/9.5 atmospheric assault lander]]. The TIE fighter was launched from hanger bays of the ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer, adjacent to the axial superlaser. This ship proved its excellence in dogfighting at the [[Battle of Exegol]], as alongside the [[Star Destroyer]]s that made up the [[Final Order]], it nearly obliterated the Resistance. After [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca]] arrived with a [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet of starships]], the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith forces]] were defeated.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
The TIE/dg starfighter features in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. The ship was first introduced with the reveal of the cover for ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' during the [[Lucasfilm]] Publishing panel held at [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic-Con]] on [[July 20]], 2019.<ref name="SDCC">{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2019-marvels-the-rise-of-kylo-ren-revealed-and-more-highlights-from-the-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2019: Marvel's ''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' Revealed and More Highlights from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}}</ref> The starfighter's official name was first identified in ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" />
